name: authentik_login_failed_burst

query_condition.sql: SELECT _timestamp, ak_action, ak_user, ak_client_ip FROM "authentik" WHERE ak_kind = 'event' AND ak_action IN ('login_failed','invalid_identifier')

description: SMS si au moins 5 echecs de connexion Authentik en 15 minutes

name: authentik_sensitive_event

query_condition.sql: SELECT _timestamp, ak_action, ak_user, ak_client_ip FROM "authentik" WHERE ak_kind = 'event' AND ak_action IN ('suspicious_request','impersonation_started','system_exception','policy_exception','configuration_error')

description: SMS si evenement Authentik sensible (requete suspecte, impersonation, exception systeme ou de politique, erreur de configuration)

name: authentik_errors

query_condition.sql: SELECT _timestamp, ak_component, ak_level, body FROM "authentik" WHERE ak_level IN ('error','critical')

description: SMS si au moins 3 erreurs Authentik (server, worker ou postgresql) en 15 minutes

name: authentik_logs_silent

query_condition.sql: SELECT ak_component, max(_timestamp) AS last_seen FROM "authentik" WHERE ak_component IN ('server','worker') GROUP BY ak_component HAVING max(_timestamp) < cast(to_unixtime(now()) AS bigint)*1000000 - 600000000

description: SMS si authentik_server ou authentik_worker n'a plus envoye de log depuis 10 minutes
